subject: Mix > 트랙 오토메이션 생성, as a coordinate-free route to an automation point
question: Can an automation point be created without a coordinate, and can a created point then be read?

reverify.expected: the script walks Logic's undo stack off this operation, drives the leaf, and finds the stack naming the operation again; exit 0
reverify.cost: needs Logic with a project and a region on the selected track; creates two automation points and undoes an operation; ~30s

canon.used_for: the submenu PARENT this record shows is not a command -- the item the previous reading actuated
the LEAF this record drives, and whose effect it measures

canon.value: 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성
canon.used_for: the name Logic ships for this operation's UNDO entry -- the string the measurement reads back, and NOT the leaf's own title, which says 오토메이션 포인트 where this says 트랙 오토메이션 포인트
the element whose AXValue the 2026-09-15 reading found absent and this one finds present

method: The previous reading of this area actuated `Mix > 트랙 오토메이션 생성` and found Logic's undo stack unchanged. That item is a SUBMENU PARENT: the en-US and ko-KR menu censuses already in this repository show seven leaves beneath it, and the parent row carries no `globalMenuItemCall:` identifier while every leaf does. So the earlier actuation drove a container, not a command. Here the leaf was driven instead, and the EFFECT was measured against Logic's own undo stack rather than a return code. Three things bracket the claim, all in this run: creating a track first proved the undo-label reader detects a change at all; the same leaf actuated with no region present left the label unmoved; and the committed reverify script walks the stack OFF this operation with Logic's own undo before driving the leaf, so a label an earlier run wrote cannot pass. That script was then mutated to click the parent instead of the leaf, which is exactly what the 2026-09-15 run did, and it failed -- re-measuring the older finding rather than arguing with it. Afterwards the arrange window was censused for any element that could represent a created point. No coordinate was used at any step.

observations.what: the submenu parent and its leaves, read live with the menu open so the enabled flags are freshly validated
the undo-label instrument, and the same leaf driven from two different starting states

readings.step: the leaf, with NO region on the track
the leaf, WITH a region present
readings.undo_after: 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소

observations.what: the committed reverify script, and the mutation that drives the parent instead of the leaf

script.undo_at_start: 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소
script.undo_after: 리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소

observations.what: the arrange window censused after the two points exist, with the automation view on

AXValueIndicator.note: fader knobs, the playhead thumbnail and the project start/end markers; none is an automation point

observations.what: 오토메이션 값, which the 2026-09-15 reading recorded as carrying no AXValue

conclusion: An automation point CAN be created without a coordinate. Driving the leaf `리전 경계에 2개의 오토메이션 포인트 생성` with a region present moved Logic's own undo stack to the name Logic ships for that operation, and the committed reverify script reaches the same reading after first walking the stack off it, so the reading is of this run and not of an earlier one. The earlier reading of this area drove `트랙 오토메이션 생성`, which is a submenu parent carrying no command identifier; mutating the script to click that parent leaves the stack unmoved and a menu open, which re-measures why that reading found a wall. Readback is the half that is still missing: with two points in the lane, a census of the arrange window found 543 elements and 0 that represent a point, so a created point cannot be located or valued through this surface. `오토메이션 값` now carries an AXValue where the 2026-09-15 reading found none, but it is one number for the whole track, it is not settable, and what it means is not established here.
limits: ko-KR only, one project, one instrument track, one three-note region.

This does NOT establish that the two points landed at the region borders, or at what value. Logic's undo label names the operation Logic believes it performed; no independent reading of either point's position or value was taken, because no surface here vends one.

The AXValue on 오토메이션 값 is a SINGLE sample with no control. Its ratio to AXMaxValue is 90/127, which invites a MIDI-scaled reading, but the volume could not be changed to test that: this host has no control surface installed, so `mixer.set_volume` cannot run, and the field is not settable through AX. The mapping is unverified, not measured.
Which change made that AXValue appear is also unmeasured -- the automation view being on, the points existing, or something else. The two readings differ in more than one way.
Only one of the seven leaves was actuated. The two `표시된 파라미터` leaves and `메인 출력에 대해 볼륨 페이드 아웃 생성` read disabled in this state and were not driven, so nothing here says whether they work when enabled.

The Event List was still not probed for automation events, and `Mix > 오토메이션 변환 > 표시된 트랙 오토메이션을 리전 오토메이션으로 변환` was not driven. Those are the two untried routes to a per-point readback and this record does not rule either in or out.
The census walked the arrange window to depth 14 from the window root. An element deeper than that, or in another window, would not appear in the 543.
